scope: Real local EPUB/PDF through production import, indexing, retrieval and QA, fresh isolated databases; no cloud or external search.
importantLimitations: Not a controlled performance comparison: GPU load and model residency changed during iterations.
Earlier nonempty citation lists include false evidence pairings; exact location and fixed anchor coverage alone are not semantic correctness.
Final full run covers six of the original ten questions. It has one supported positive answer, two correct abstentions, three failed positive answers.
Mother-unconditional remains a retrieval failure; love-elements review returned relevance=5 outside 0..1 and invented source 7; mamba-speed bad evidence pairs were rejected.
The independent pair model still overaccepted one incomplete comparison in an isolated probe. The all-pairs gate rejected the overall answer because another pair failed; no universal guarantee.
One earlier EPUB indexing run took 156653ms under model residency pressure; final cold run took 5466ms. No general speedup claim.
Installed desktop, GitHub and Anna releases unchanged.
